title: Speech Tokenizers are Vulnerable: Transferable Semantic Attack and Robust Tokenizer
abstract: arXiv:2611.14929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech tokenizers serve as speech front ends, encoding input speech signals into representations for downstream models, such as automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems and large audio-language models (LALMs). In this paper, we find that speech tokenizers are fragile at the semantic level: small perturbations can disrupt their semantic encoding process and consequently cause severe degradation in downstream ASR and LALM performance. To study this vulnerability, we propose T-SemAttack, a transferable semantic attack based on a semantic encoder ensemble. By jointly drifting the representation spaces of multiple semantic encoders, T-SemAttack effectively disrupts the semantic content of speech while preserving perceptual quality, thereby inducing error features. translated_title: 语音分词器是脆弱的：可迁移语义攻击与鲁棒分词器
translated_abstract: 语音分词器作为语音前端，将输入的语音信号编码为表示，供下游模型使用，例如自动语音识别（ASR）系统和大型音频-语言模型（LALM）。在本文中，我们发现语音分词器在语义层面是脆弱的：微小的扰动即可破坏其语义编码过程，进而导致下游ASR和LALM性能的严重退化。为了研究这种脆弱性，我们提出了T-SemAttack，一种基于语义编码器集成的可迁移语义攻击方法。通过联合漂移多个语义编码器的表示空间，T-SemAttack能够在保持感知质量的同时有效破坏语音的语义内容，从而诱导产生错误特征。我们进一步分析了逐层表示漂移与跨模型梯度对齐。研究结果表明，扰动能够在深层语义表示中引起显著的偏移……
tldr: 本文揭示了语音分词器在语义层面的脆弱性，提出基于语义编码器集成的可迁移语义攻击方法T-SemAttack，它能在保持感知质量的同时破坏语音语义并严重降低下游ASR和LALM的性能，并据此构建了鲁棒分词器。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the semantic-level vulnerability of speech tokenizers and proposes T-SemAttack, a transferable semantic attack based on a semantic encoder ensemble, which disrupts speech semantics while preserving perceptual quality and severely degrades downstream ASR and LALM performance, leading to a robust tokenizer design.
